subtitle: A Blue Flag cove on Ibiza's west coast, its shoreline built out for half a century without the paperwork to make it official.
spike_statement: In May 2025, Cala Vedella owners asked Sant Josep to formally take over an urbanización over 90% built, 52 years after its 1973 development plan was approved.

levers.photo_tone: Pale limestone headlands cupping a turquoise cove, sand bright but the light flat and administrative rather than romantic
